prompts.prompt: Use case: productivity-visual. Create ONE full-page CV background image, portrait A4 aspect ratio, high resolution. Executive editorial style: almost white ivory background, exceedingly fine charcoal and muted champagne double-rule accent only along the extreme left edge, tiny elegant corner geometry bottom right. Restrained traditional luxury stationery. Flat full-bleed digital artwork, no photographed paper, no shadows, no mockup. Keep central 85% of page completely blank near-white for black CV text. Decoration limited to outer 5% margins and small corner tips. Very low ink coverage. No text, letters, labels, icons, placeholder lines, logos, watermark or border cutting into content. Professional printable resume background asset.
